title: Find the nationality and constructor name of the team that accumulated the
question: Find the nationality and constructor name of the team that accumulated the most points in all Turkish Grand Prix races between 2005 and 2011, and also determine the longest pit stop duration ever recorded by any driver from that constructor.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_constructor AS (
  SELECT c.XCL_022 AS constructor_id, c.XCL_024 AS constructor_name, c.XCL_025 AS nationality
  FROM races r
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.XCL_065 = ds.XCL_028
  JOIN drivers d ON ds.XCL_029 = d.XCL_034
  JOIN qualifying q ON d.XCL_034 = q.XCL_058
  JOIN constructors c ON q.XCL_059 = c.XCL_022
  WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Turkish Grand Prix' AND r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2005 AND 2011
  GROUP BY c.XCL_022, c.XCL_024, c.XCL_025
  ORDER BY SUM(ds.XCL_030) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT tc.nationality, tc.constructor_name, MAX(ps.XCL_054) AS longest_pit_stop
FROM top_constructor tc
JOIN qualifying q ON tc.constructor_id = q.XCL_059
JOIN drivers d ON q.XCL_058 = d.XCL_034
JOIN pitStops ps ON d.XCL_034 = ps.XCL_050

WITH top_constructor AS (
  SELECT c.XCL_022 AS constructor_id, c.XCL_024 AS constructor_name, c.XCL_025 AS nationality
  FROM races r
  JOIN driverStandings ds ON r.XCL_065 = ds.XCL_028
  JOIN drivers d ON ds.XCL_029 = d.XCL_034
  JOIN qualifying q ON d.XCL_034 = q.XCL_058
  JOIN constructors c ON q.XCL_059 = c.XCL_022
  WHERE r.XCL_069 = 'Turkish Grand Prix' AND r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2005 AND 2011
  GROUP BY c.XCL_022, c.XCL_024, c.XCL_025
  ORDER BY SUM(ds.XCL_030) DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT tc.nationality, tc.constructor_name, MAX(ps.XCL_054) AS longest_pit_stop
FROM top_constructor tc
JOIN qualifying q ON tc.constructor_id = q.XCL_059
JOIN drivers d ON q.XCL_058 = d.XCL_034
JOIN pitStops ps ON d.XCL_034 = ps.XCL_050

WITH turkish_gp_races AS (
    SELECT r.XCL_065 AS race_id
    FROM races r
    JOIN circuits c ON r.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
    JOIN seasons s ON r.XCL_066 = s.XCL_091
    WHERE c.XCL_003 = 'Turkey'
      AND s.XCL_091 BETWEEN 2005 AND 2011
),
constructor_points AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.XCL_012 AS constructor_id,
        SUM(cr.XCL_013) AS total_points
    FROM constructorResults cr
    JOIN turkish_gp_races tgr ON cr.XCL_011 = tgr.race_id
    GROUP BY cr.XCL_012
),
top_constructor AS (
    SELECT constructor_id
    FROM constructor_points
    ORDER BY total_points DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
drivers_of_top_constructor AS (
    SELECT d.XCL_034 AS driver_id
    FROM drivers d
    JOIN results res ON d.XCL_034 = res.XCL_075
    WHERE res.XCL_076 = (SELECT constructor_id FROM top_constructor)
)
SELECT 
    c.XCL_024 AS nationality,
    c.XCL_023 AS constructor_name,
    MAX(ps.XCL_053) AS longest_pit_stop_duration
FROM constructors c
JOIN top_constructor tc ON c.XCL_022 = tc.constructor_id
JOIN drivers_of_top_constructor dotc ON 1=1
JOIN pitStops ps ON dotc.driver_id = ps.XCL_050
GROUP BY c.XCL_022
